headline: Brazil Senate Approves Fiscal Adjustment Bill Targeting BRL 56.1 Billion Savings
summary: The Brazilian Senate has approved a fiscal adjustment bill projected to save up to BRL 56.1 billion in 2027. The legislation now moves to the House of Representatives for final review.
why: Fiscal policy in Brazil is a primary concern for international investors monitoring the country's debt sustainability and inflation control measures.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Fiscal consolidation is generally viewed as positive for sovereign credit risk and currency stability.
